voltage_reference.description: Nominal system voltage. Single-phase: line voltage. Three-phase: line-to-line voltage. Also the denominator of voltage_drop_percent, and used as V when load_type='power'.

length.description: ONE-WAY conductor route length (not round-trip). The single-phase formula applies the out-and-back factor of 2 internally; do not double this value yourself.

power.description: Active power. Required iff load_type='power'; current is derived via voltage_reference and power_factor.

resistance_per_length.description: Alternative to material+cross_section: the conductor's own resistance per unit length.

reactance_per_length.description: Optional; defaults to 0 (common practice for smaller cross-sections where reactance is negligible).

material.description: Alternative to resistance_per_length: derive resistance from material resistivity and cross_section. Must be given together with cross_section.

cross_section.description: Conductor cross-sectional area. Must be given together with material.
